visualCharacteristics.purpose: dated list of ASX releases with a pager (Previous, page numbers, Next) and a "Showing x–y of N" count; optionally a live yourir ASX announcements feed with server-side paging and filtering

contentPattern.structure: optional config rows (key cell, case-insensitive): Page size | number (default 10, 15 in feed mode); Feed | yourir symbol (e.g. tcl.asx); App ID | yourir app ID. Feed + App ID together switch on feed mode. Then one row per release: date cell (plain text, e.g. 19 November 2026) | title cell (link, or plain text); in feed mode these rows are the initial render and the fallback

reuseGuidance: Use for long dated lists of releases or announcements that need paging. Place directly after a releases-filter block in the same section to make it searchable; paging follows the filter.
